quest.title: An Artist Adrift
quest.description: The famous artist from Fontaine, Julien, remains in Sumeru...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x200, Primogem x30, Mora x15000, Hero's Wit x2

talks.objective: Go to the camp by the water

dialogues.speaker: Julien
dialogues.text: #Paimon, {NICKNAME}, you're here! Ah, indeed, one needs friends when on a journey outdoors.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, we did agree to show you the way, didn't we? Guiding people around is a walk in the park for us! Even though we'll be walking in a desert...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But are you sure you want to go back to Fontaine so soon? You made it all the way to Sumeru, after all. There's still so much to see here!

choices.text: The rainforest has some nice views.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: There's lots of trees and rivers!

response.speaker: Julien
response.text: They all sound really nice, but I feel that... I haven't made proper preparations for travel. This trip might've been a failure, but I suppose I did learn a lesson or two...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, um... In that case, there's also great stuff to see nearby! It would be a pity if you missed them all.

response.speaker: Julien
response.text: If you insist... I guess it would be rude if I were to refuse.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehe, Paimon's Teyvat's number one guide, so leave the guiding to Paimon! Just remember to keep up.

choices.text: The desert has some fascinating sights.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Sand and ruins as far as your eyes can see!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: They say that artists will observe their subject from many angles before they start. Is that some sort of... "stereotype"?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We could have a look around first, and if that fails, we can find a vantage point with a better view!

dialogues.speaker: Julien
dialogues.text: That sounds like a good idea. I'm ready to set out.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Hehe, shall we race to the destination? Are you ready, {NICKNAME}?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This place is filled with nature's scent! Doesn't it just make you feel like sketching? Doesn't it make you feel inspired?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Now that's a stereotype.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Um... But it does make Paimon wanna pick up a brush! This place is so full of vitality, and the colors are so vivid...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Ahem.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon's sorry... Paimon didn't mean to...

dialogues.speaker: Julien
dialogues.text: Haha, it's fine. I just see something different, that's all. We can all appreciate beauty, right?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's right! Paimon loves this place. It's almost as if it can purify your heart and soul.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Not that you need it, Paimon.

dialogues.speaker: Julien
dialogues.text: My friends, thank you for showing me such kindness — even to someone like me, who has failed to tell you the truth from the beginning.

dialogues.speaker: Julien
dialogues.text: You are both indeed pure of heart.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe... No need to exaggerate so much. Oh, and there are actually more unique sights than this!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Paimon's sure you know what she's referring to, {NICKNAME}. Let's show it to Julien as well!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let's go!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's go!

talks.objective: Go to a vantage point with a better view

dialogues.speaker: Julien
dialogues.text: Phew... I didn't think that drawing was such a taxing thing to do. If I had known that, I would've...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Looks like that was still a bit much for Julien...

dialogues.speaker: Julien
dialogues.text: Well, I did just... recover from my injuries... *pants*

dialogues.speaker: Julien
dialogues.text: But the sights here are truly unique. Indeed, I think it's strange that I never noticed them before...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The view's pretty good up ahead as well. Let's head over there — but be careful, okay?

talks.objective: Leave the vantage point and keep moving

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: How's that? Pretty nice, eh? Pepper also seemed really happy.

dialogues.speaker: Julien
dialogues.text: Having seen this, I find that words seem superfluous. Caterpillar was right. There is such a wide world outside my metal box...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: A metal box... You said that you lived in a very small place in Fontaine, didn't you?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Ahem. Sumeru sure does have lots of sights to see, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ah, right, that's right! He's already decided to be a proper artist, so let's switch up the scene a bit to... what do they call it... broaden our horizons!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: He might have said that he wants to give up, but Paimon thinks it's still too early for that! There's still time to reconsider...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Just think about it, Julien! There might be sights just as grand as this, or maybe even grander — things you've never seen before! Maybe they'll grant you the inspiration you need!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: As for your color recognition, well, you said it yourself! We just "see something different"...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: But we can all appreciate beauty.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah!

dialogues.speaker: Julien
dialogues.text: Yes... Your words do make sense.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Those were your words!

dialogues.speaker: Julien
dialogues.text: I... Haha, so I knew it. I knew it after all, but I just kept walking the wrong path...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We only met because Pepper brought you here, right? So we shouldn't just think of it as the "wrong path"!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, it's a shame that we couldn't help you find the path of the Oceanids' pilgrimage, though...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Does that even exist...

dialogues.speaker: Julien
dialogues.text: I've always believed it does, but... I think that my ability or lack thereof to find it is unimportant either way.

dialogues.speaker: Julien
dialogues.text: After all, I've already found the answer I desire.

dialogues.speaker: Julien
dialogues.text: Thank you, my friends. *sigh* How can I ever show my gratitude?

dialogues.speaker: Julien
dialogues.text: If only I had bought those mysterious bird eggs... A mystical item like that, one that can help to ward off ill fortune, would certainly be of more use to adventurers like you.

choices.text: That does seem like a bit of a pity.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Wait, do you really believe in something that convenient, {NICKNAME}?

response.speaker: Julien
response.text: I will continue to stay here for a while. This place really calms the soul. It's quite good for self-reflection.

response.speaker: Julien
response.text: I have a feeling that I might be able to draw something a little different this time...

response.speaker: Julien
response.text: Thank you both, dear friends. I wish you smooth sailing in your journey!

choices.text: It's fine, but I don't think it's necessary.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Why not? Even if it can't really deflect bad luck, maybe... maybe it might taste a hundred times better than a normal egg!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let's make some preparations first.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Alright then. Let's go once we're ready!

dialogues.speaker: Julien
dialogues.text: One of the good things about leaving the city is not having to specially prepare dog food. Pepper's very capable, in any case, and can procure its own meals.

dialogues.speaker: Julien
dialogues.text: The bad thing, though, is that I lack any talent for combat or cooking. I suppose "city trash" is a fitting name for one such as myself...

dialogues.speaker: Julien
dialogues.text: I should just focus on recovering.

dialogues.speaker: Pepper
dialogues.text: (Looks at you expectantly.)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We previously agreed to guide Julien, and he should've recovered from his injuries by now, right? Why don't we go see him?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: If he's learned his lesson, he should be waiting for us at the seaside camp, right?

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Julien cannot keep up. Perhaps you may find him back at the start.
